motion.name: deck-deal
motion.value: grid grows 260ms, then cards fly 620ms staggered 70ms, cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)
motion.purpose: Opening a project deals its stacked works; disabled with reduced motion.

motion.name: deck-gather
motion.value: cards gather 480ms staggered 60ms, then grid shrinks 320ms
motion.purpose: Stacking a project; rows never stretch while the grid height animates.

motion.name: tumble
motion.purpose: Error page moment; disabled with reduced motion.

narrative.overview: White page, black Gabarito type, one solid paint colour per project, chunky rounded tiles, a fanned deck for older work and magazine-style articles.
keyCharacteristics: Project chip, two newest works and a deck per row; four columns on desktop, two on phones.
Twelve stable project paints with black or white text at 4.5:1 or better; unassigned is black.
Huge black article titles, plain drop cap, yellow pull quotes, hand-of-chips back link.
dos: Preserve live updates, native links and meaningful keyboard focus.
Keep colour in solid tiles and small accents on a white page.
donts: No gradients, glass, glow, pastels or coloured page backgrounds.
No colour bands behind headline words or the drop cap.
No external font requests or project-wide branding changes.
